title: A Deadline for the Contact
author: Hazel Zhou
blurb: Rafael Dunmore, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
